grades.quote: Because each page directory can no longer span the full 4-GiB virtual address range, PAE requires adding a third level to the top of the tree.
grades.reason: Provides background on page-table hierarchy, but does not explain avoiding lower-level tables for unused ranges.

grades.quote: Xv6 performs a few: mapping the same memory (a trampoline page) in several address spaces, guarding kernel and user stacks with an unmapped page, and allocating user heap memory lazily.
grades.reason: Offers background on unmapped and lazily allocated memory, but not multilevel page-table space savings.
